items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Highly efficient on low-volume day
items.text:
Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing three times for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Warren: Little with four catches Sunday
items.text:
Warren secured four of 10 targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.title: Parker Washington: Remains quiet in Week 8 win
items.text:
Washington brought in one of two targets for 16 yards and rushed once for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

items.title: Gardner Minshew: Leads Cards to comeback win
items.text:
Minshew completed 17 of 23 passes for 188 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions after he replaced starting QB Jacoby Brissett late in the third quarter of Sunday's 33-30 overtime win in Dallas.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Rushing touchdown in Week 8 win
items.text:
Williams rushed 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown and brought in his sole target for three yards in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
